prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no one “best” AI video ad maker — the right choice depends on what you need (talking‑head ads vs quick social clips vs highly creative visuals, budget, languages, scale). Below are top options by use case so you can pick quickly.

If you want a single recommendation (general-purpose, high quality, easy): Synthesia — best for fast, professional talking‑head ads with realistic AI presenters and multilingual voiceovers.

Best by use case
- Talking‑head / presenter ads: Synthesia or HeyGen (realistic avatars, excellent lip sync, multilingual). Good for product explainers, testimonials, CTA-driven ads.
- Repurposing long content / script → short ads: Pictory — automatic highlights, captions, stock clips; great for social snippets.
- Fast social/video ads with templates: InVideo or Lumen5 — lots of templates, easy editing, affordable.
- Creative / generative visuals and advanced editing: Runway — best for novel visuals, background removal, generative frames.
- Full ad production + stock library + distribution focus: Promo.com — templates and branding geared toward paid social/YouTube ads.
- All‑around editor with collaboration + AI tools: VEED — good for teams, captions, auto‑translations.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Format: talking‑head vs montage vs animation?
- Scale: one ad or hundreds localized versions?
- Output quality vs speed: studio polish (Synthesia/Runway) vs quick & cheap (Lumen5/InVideo)?
- Languages & voices: do you need many localizations?
- Budget: enterprise pricing (Synthesia, Runway) vs affordable monthly (InVideo, Pictory).
- Assets: do you already have footage or start from text?

Things to watch for
- Licensing for stock footage/music.
- Platform ad policies (deepfake rules on social platforms).
- Voice/narration naturalness and lip sync if using avatars.

If you tell me: 1) what type of ad (talking‑head, social clip, animated), 2) platform (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube), 3) budget and whether you need many localized versions — I’ll recommend the single best tool and a quick workflow.
